outcome: Exploration time in Y Maze test
Time spent in the open arm of Elevated Plus Maze test
Expression of genes associated with neuroimmune interactions (microglia phenotype)
Expression of lipids in brain structures
cohort: Male and female mice born either naturally (vaginal delivery) or by C-section, adopted by dams, and followed through post-natal day 21, 55, and 64.
finding: Animals delivered by C-section exhibited altered emotional behaviour and underlying neuro-inflammatory processes in different brain regions compared to vaginally delivered animals.
mod_finding: Animals born by C-section showed significantly higher body weight in late adolescence, lower exploration, abnormal social interaction, and decreased time in the open arm of the Elevated Plus Maze, along with altered neuroimmune and inflammatory gene expression in the brain, compared to those born by vaginal delivery.
